title: Three Years and One Short Plan
subtitle: 数据统计 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）
meta: 主题语境：数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）　|　核心词汇：population　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 population 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1961 the planner ① counted the population that no citizen in the district would have counted, and he said the counting was the whole of the year. The ② population, meaning the number itself and not the plan, ran three years and stayed uncounted in the book; population, he said, is the only thing in a district that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ sort of population in that district had the same short plan beside it, and the ④ population at the far square, meaning the plot they kept for the children to measure and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Population, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the planner said the counting is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the population was the whole of the matter, meaning the pressure and not the number. The ⑥ population, meaning the pressure and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; population, he said, is either something you count or the only word that means both number and a pressure. He said the pressure is the part they remember.

By 1966 the ⑦ population had become a line in a report, and the report had become an argument about the short plan. The ⑧ population of the whole thing, the planner wrote in March, was one district and three years of counting; population, he said, is either the plot at the far square or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ population I remember is the population counted in the report, which closed in 1968 and is still counted as the quietest in the district. ⑩ Population, my mother said in 1970, is the only thing that improves by being counted; all population, she said, is a pressure that has agreed to look like number. She said the pressure was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 人口（指街区里每一类旁边的那一类）
B. n. 人口（指那份人口本身，与薄薄的图纸相对）
C. 固定搭配：count the population 统计这一份人口
D. n. 人口（指留给孩子们丈量的那一块）
E. n. 人口之事（抽象总称，指一处街区的人口之事）
F. n. 人口（指规划报告里写到、被清点的那一份）
G. n. 人口、压力（指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 压力（抽象总称，指人人都用却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: counted the population that no citizen in the district would have counted

answers.why: count the population 意为“统计这一份人口”，1961 年那位规划员把街区里没有一位市民肯清点的一份人口做了一遍。
population 意为“人口”，指那份人口本身而不是薄薄的图纸，它经过了三个年份而在簿子上没有被清点。
population 意为“人口”，指街区里每一类旁边的那一类，每一类旁边都有同一张薄薄的图纸。
population 意为“人口”，指最远那处广场的留给孩子们丈量的那一块，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
population 意为“人口、压力”，指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份压力就是那件事的全部。
population 意为“压力”，指人人都用却无人提起的那样东西而不是那份人口，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
population 意为“人口”，指规划报告里写到、被清点的那一份，到 1966 年这一份成了规划报告里的一行。
population 意为“人口之事”，规划员三月写道，整件事的人口之事是一处街区和三个年份的清点。
population 意为“人口”，我记得的是规划报告里清点过的那一份，1968 年落成了，至今仍被说成街区里最安静的一份。
population 为抽象总称，母亲 1970 年说，人口是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的人口。
